The Banu are a spacefaring civilization and Humanity's first confirmed extrasolar contact. In 2438 explorer Vernon Tar met a fugitive Banu ship in the Davien system, and the Interstellar Peace and Trade Accord was signed that October.

The Xi'an are an ancient, technologically advanced spacefaring civilization. Contact began in 2530 when Gaia Planet Services tried to terraform a world the Xi'an claim, starting a long Cold War. Senator Akari and Emperor Kr.ē's 2789 treaty ended it unofficially, and the Perry Line Pact formalized the end in 2793.

The Tevarin are a bipedal spacefaring people. First contact in 2541 led to the First Tevarin War (2541-2546) and the annexation of their systems. Warlord Corath'Thal's bid to retake Jalan (Elysium IV) began the Second Tevarin War (2603-2610). Surviving Tevarin then joined the UEE and are experiencing a cultural revival.

The Vanduul are a hostile, clan-based spacefaring civilization. Humanity first encountered them in 2681 when a Vanduul Clan raided Dell Township on Armitage (Orion III). Attempts to establish diplomatic relations have failed.
Project-created xenological reconstruction. No Quasi civilization matching this dossier turned up in the RSI or community-wiki sources checked, so the entry stays flagged as speculative.

The Hadesians were an indigenous interplanetary civilization in the Hades system. Ruins of their worlds show they died out long before Humans arrived. The prevailing theory is that they destroyed themselves in a civil war roughly 300,000 years ago. Sources differ on the exact year of the first human survey.

Garron II held a developing sapient species, the first non-spacefaring civilization Humanity found. Imperator Linton Messer XI's regime terraformed the planet despite this, and a Tide broadcast in April 2792 showed that the species was gone. The footage helped ignite the revolution that ended the Messer Era.

Phare's Ape is a canon alien animal: a vaguely Human-like primate that biologists think may have the potential to develop higher thinking. It is included in this archive as a xenobiology entry, not as a confirmed spacefaring civilization.
The Orms are a sentient species living in the northern polar region of Xis. Patek Coen discovered them in 2811. They are classed as a developing civilization, with their culture dated to around 2840.

Genesis II is home to several sapient species. An ocean-dwelling cephalopod civilization whose factions have begun incursions onto land and violent clashes with the avian-reptoids. The Fair Chance Act forbids all outside interference, and scientists debate whether to let the conflict run its course.

Genesis II is home to several sapient species. A land-dwelling avian-reptoid civilization and one of the planet's best-documented, locked in deadly clashes with the ocean-dwelling cephalopods. The Fair Chance Act forbids all outside interference, and scientists debate whether to let the conflict run its course.

The Osoians are a developing civilization indigenous to Oso II. They use tools and weapons, live in villages, and communicate in part through flashes of color produced by the skin of their foreheads. They are protected under the Fair Chance Act.

Kins II is a canon location in the Banu-controlled Kins system, but the lost-civilization interpretation in this portrait is a project reconstruction and not a confirmed species dossier. It stays flagged as speculative.

The Kr'Thak are a sentient spacefaring civilization known to Humanity largely through Xi'an information. The UEE has debated attempting contact, but direct Human knowledge remains extremely limited because of the Xi'an-Kr'Thak conflict and the geography of their territory.
First Human Contact with the Banu
On 12 June 2438 explorer Vernon Tar met a fugitive Banu ship in the Davien system and reported his position. A UNE delegation followed, and the Banu Protectorate made formal contact two weeks later.
Banu-Human Interstellar Peace and Trade Accord
The UNE and Banu Protectorate signed the first interspecies treaty in Human history, formalizing peaceful relations and trade.
Hidden Jump Point to Hades Detected
The crew of the Merry Crow detected an undocumented jump point in Nexus. Its destination would remain uncharted by Humanity for years.
Gaia Planet Services attempted to terraform a world the Xi'an claim. The incident marked first contact and began the prolonged tension known as the Xi'an-Human Cold War.
Hades System Surveyed — Extinct Civilization Confirmed

Dynamo Corporation navigated the Hades jump point. Surveys revealed ruins of a previously unknown spacefaring civilization devastated by ancient interplanetary war. Sources differ on the exact year of this first survey.
Tevarin First Contact and the First Tevarin War
Dr. Kellar Lench discovered the Tevarin system. Hostilities followed first contact, beginning the First Tevarin War.
A major UPE victory on 1 October 2544 turned the tide of the First Tevarin War and elevated Ivar Messer's public profile.
The Tevarin were defeated and their systems, including Elysium, were annexed by the UPE. The conflict's aftermath reshaped Human and Tevarin history.
Warlord Corath'Thal launched a campaign to reclaim the Tevarin home system, igniting the Second Tevarin War.
Squadron 42 helped disable Corath'Thal's fleet during the final campaign, allowing UEE forces to destroy the Tevarin armada and end the war.
Astravin University researchers published a major theory that an interplanetary war caused the extinction of the Hadesian civilization.
A Vanduul raiding party destroyed Dell Township on Armitage (Orion III), becoming Humanity's first confirmed encounter with the Vanduul.
Battle of Orion: System Lost to the Vanduul
On 16-18 February 2712 thousands of Vanduul and a Kingship entered Orion from a previously unknown jump point. The UEE lost, ceded the system, and suffered its first major defeat in decades.
Akari-Kr.ē Treaty — Xi'an-Human Cold War Thaws
Senator Terrence Akari and Xi'an Emperor Kr.ē negotiated the treaty in secret on Tohil III. It brought the unofficial end of the Xi'an-Human Cold War and pulled Xi'an forces back from the Perry Line.

Terraforming under Imperator Linton Messer XI eliminated a developing sapient species. A Tide broadcast in April 2792 showed the result, and the public turned against the Messers, leading to the Anti-Messer Revolution.
Following the Garron II atrocity, the UEE enacted protections intended to prevent Humanity from destroying developing indigenous civilizations through terraforming or interference.
The Ark Established as a Repository of Knowledge

Construction of the Ark finished in orbit around Tayac I. Imperator Marshall Leon's idea was a neutral meeting place for all species and a repository of galactic knowledge, and its archivists curate the Galactapedia and Starmap.
Patek Coen discovered the Orms, a developing sentient species living in the northern polar region of Xis.
Oso System Discovered — Osoian Civilization Protected
Human surveys of the Oso system revealed the developing civilization on Oso II. The system was subsequently protected under the Fair Chance Act.
The UEE announced Synthworld / Project Archangel as an attempt to support expansion without repeating the destructive consequences of terraforming inhabited worlds.
Phare's Ape Added to the Biological Archive
Phare's Ape is a canon fauna entry in the Galactapedia animal archive. The current project database does not attach a verified historical discovery date to this entry.
Genesis II Sapient Civilizations Under Observation
Several sapient species live on Genesis II. Land-dwelling avian-reptoids and ocean-dwelling cephalopods are clashing, while the Fair Chance Act prohibits intervention.
Humanity has no direct confirmed contact with the Kr'Thak. UEE knowledge is largely indirect and constrained by Xi'an relations and territorial geography.
Speculative project entry associated with ancient ruins. No CIG-canon chronology is asserted for this record.
Unconfirmed project intelligence record. This entry is intentionally separated from CIG canon until reliable lore exists.
Perry Line Pact Ends the Xi'an-Human Cold War
The Perry Line Pact, signed on 5 July 2793, formally closed the Cold War that the 2789 Akari-Kr.ē Treaty had ended unofficially.

The UEE's showcase system, named after the capital planet Terra III, which is becoming the cultural focus of the Empire. Ruins of an unidentified ancient civilization lie on its southern continent.
